paras: Latastia  siebenrocki, also known commonly as Siebenrock's longtail lizard or Siebenrock's long-tailed lizard, is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is endemic to  Guinea.
The specific name, siebenrocki, is in honor of Austrian herpetologist Friedrich Siebenrock.
L. siebenrocki is found in Conakry, Guinea.
The preferred natural habitat of L. siebenrocki is unknown.
